title: Switch alignment to GRPO / RLVR - RLHF decision superseded
content: DeepSeek-R1 (2501.12948) and GRPO/RLVR beat our RLHF stack on math and code with no reward model to keep alive. Alignment default is now GRPO with verifiable rewards. The InstructGPT/RLHF decision is superseded. PPO configs stay archived; do not start new RM labeling.

title: Long context plus memory tools - RAG-as-default superseded
content: The 128k+ windows and agent-memory tools made naive RAG the wrong default. Factual questions now go to long context first; durable lab facts go to remember/recall with decay. RAG is only for huge, rarely-read corpora. The Lewis/RAG-as-architecture decision is superseded.

title: Full finetune the 70B; LoRA only for experiments - LoRA-default superseded
content: The new cluster can full-finetune the 70B overnight. LoRA underfit the domain mix on the last three customer adapters. Default for production adaptation is now a full finetune. LoRA stays for prototypes and multi-tenant adapters only. The Hu/LoRA-for-every-finetune decision is superseded.

title: Do not keep citing the 2024 process-supervision paper - failed to replicate
content: We spent two weeks trying to reproduce the 2024 process-supervision gains on our math split (the one everyone bookmarked last spring). Reward-model-over-steps did not beat outcome-only GRPO on our harness. Do not keep citing it as SOTA or as why we need a process RM. Treat it as a negative result for this lab.

title: Cluster can full-finetune 70B; 8xH100 box is the training default
content: Training default is the 8xH100 box. A 70B full finetune on the instruction mix finishes overnight; LoRA is no longer required to hit the budget. Inference still merges or serves full weights. This is why the adaptation default could move.

title: LoRA rank 16 underfit the last three customer adapters
content: Customer A/B/C adapters trained with the LoRA template all plateaued ~3 points below a matched full finetune on the holdout. Rank 64 helped a little, not enough. This is the evidence behind dropping LoRA as the production default.

title: RAG missed long-doc facts that fit in the 128k window
content: On the Q2 factuality set, chunked RAG (k=8) dropped citations that were in-document but outside the retrieved chunks. Stuffing the same docs into a 128k context recovered them. Retrieval stays for the wiki dump; it is the wrong first tool for anything that fits in context.

title: GRPO run on the math split beat PPO-RLHF - keep going
content: First GRPO/RLVR run (recipe close to DeepSeek-R1, 2501.12948) beat our production PPO-RLHF checkpoint on GSM8K-style and LiveCodeBench-internal. No RM to retrain. Staffing should move off RM labeling.
